de nas 'pho ba ye shes sgron me 'di/ tshe dbang rig 'dzin dpal gyis mthong grol la/ mkha' 'gro dkar mo mdangs ldan 'od 'phro yis/ phyi rabs don du zab mo gser 'dra zhus/ dus mtha'i kho bo pad ma g.yung drung la/ mkha' 'gro mdangs ldan snyan rgyud tshul du snang / mu steg (stegs) ru tra can la gsang dang rgya/ bstan na mkha' 'gro ma sring bka' las chad/ zhib rgyas ma gsal bla ma'i thugs la gab/ sA mA yA rgya rgya rgya/ lho nas tsha ba khe shod la/ khro sprul sku g.yung drung nyi shar gyis/ dus yang yang bskul ba'i ngor/ bka' (dkar) chag yi ge ris su btab pa yin/ nyes 'gal mchis na ma sring tshogs la bshags/ dus kyi mtha' la 'gro ba'i dpal gyur cig nyon mongs sems can 'dam las drangs pa dang / thugs rje 'dren pa'i lcags kyu myur 'grub shog/
